description: The case field `preload` (harness item T17): the templates `data_php` loads with `$twig->load()`, which both runners load at the end of the load phase, after the main template. Without it a template that fails to compile or load stopped the oracle in phase `data` without typed data, and the case could not be compared (192 of 30000 composition cases of round 4). The failures come in phase `load`, after the compile-time deprecations of the templates preloaded before; the controls preload templates that load (also with `load_all`, where preloading changes nothing) and a main template that fails before the preload. Recorded with twig-fuzz record ("isolation": "process").
